text: Hi, I'm Talha Rehman, a Full-Stack Software Engineer based in Islamabad, Pakistan.

I have around two years of hands-on experience building and shipping production web applications using React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL — commonly known as the MERN and PERN stacks. I also work with Next.js for building fast, scalable frontend applications.

Currently, I maintain live client products at LiveTalk. Before that, I spent six months at Brandora, where I delivered three internal products end to end — including the company website, an internal office management tool, and an interactive web game.

Recently, I've been focused on LLM engineering and Retrieval-Augmented Generation, or RAG. I've built an ERP-style inventory and operations module inside an LLM-powered pharmacy platform as my final year project, along with a geospatial restaurant-discovery app.

I work with OpenAI APIs, Ollama models, and the Anthropic API — creating, fine-tuning, and comparing different models to find the most business-efficient and cost-effective solution for a client's specific problem.
I also build automation pipelines using n8n, connecting REST APIs, databases, and LLMs together to automate manual, repetitive tasks.
I enjoy owning a feature end to end — from API design, through the user interface, to deployment — while working in an Agile team.
I'm available immediately for onsite, remote, or hybrid roles. Let's build something great together.
